description: Map the velocity field of a sample from its own correlations — one arrow per tile, over the image. No model and no fit: the velocity is read off where a correlation peak is. Ships a simulated demo whose flow profile is known, so the arrows can be checked.

rpc_methods.name: img_flow.map.compute
rpc_methods.summary: Map the velocity field of an image stack or photon stream.

filename.description: TIFF stack or photon stream to map. It needs at least three frames: a flow map measures what moved between them.

method.description: Estimator: 'stics' tracks where the correlation peak moves (2-D); 'pcf' tracks when molecules arrive a distance away (1-D, resolved per pixel, and able to report no transport).

channel.description: Image channel to map, by index or name.

tile.description: Tile size in pixels: the spatial resolution of the map, traded against how many molecules each tile holds.

step.description: Distance between tile origins; 0 uses half a tile, so tiles overlap.

n_lags.description: STICS: frame lags 0..N-1. The peak must stay inside the tile over the whole range, or it wraps and the fitted velocity points the wrong way.

distance.description: Pair correlation: the pair distance in pixels.

subtract_average.description: 'frame' removes each frame's own mean; 'stack' also removes the time-averaged image, i.e. the immobile fraction.

pixel_duration_us.description: Pixel dwell in microseconds; the line and frame times are derived from it when they are left at zero.

line_duration_ms.description: Line time in ms. 0 derives it from the dwell.

frame_duration_ms.description: Frame time in ms — the clock a STICS velocity is measured against. 0 derives it from the dwell.

pixel_size_nm.description: Pixel size in nm. Every velocity scales linearly with it.

min_quality.description: Drop tiles whose straight-line fit is worse than this. Peak jitter always yields some slope, so an unfiltered map can show a flow field on a static sample.

output_path.description: Optional CSV path for the per-tile vectors.

rpc_methods.name: img_flow.methods.list
rpc_methods.summary: List the estimators and what each of them can and cannot see.

rpc_methods.name: img_flow.demo.create
rpc_methods.summary: Simulate a photon stream with a known flow profile and write it as PTU.

path.description: Where to write it; defaults to the ChiSurf settings directory.

overwrite.description: Regenerate even when the file is already there.

n_frames.description: Frames to scan; more frames means less scatter and a longer wait.

v_max.description: Peak flow speed in um/s at the channel centre.

diffusion_coefficient.description: Diffusion coefficient of the simulated molecules, in um^2/s.
